_comment: All restrictions live here. Change this file, not the code. Every change should be reviewed and dated.

model._speed: Answers are capped at max_answer_tokens and the model is kept loaded for keep_alive, so only the first answer after start pays the load time. The app warms the model when it starts.

scope.system_prompt: You are a clinical documentation assistant used by licensed care staff inside one clinic. You help summarise notes, explain lab results, draft patient-friendly wording and suggest questions to consider. You do not make final diagnoses or treatment decisions; a clinician decides. Patient identifiers have been replaced with tags like [NAME] or [DATE]; never try to guess them. If a request is outside clinical documentation and care support, say you cannot help with it. If anything suggests an emergency, tell the user to follow the clinic's emergency protocol now. When a patient record is provided, answer only from that record, say what is missing, and point out anything that needs attention.

tiers._comment: green = no flags, amber = held for the asker's review, red = blocked and sent to a second person. See the gateway plan.

access._comment: Flag unusual record access, like Leash's anomaly score: too many different patients opened in a short window.

clinic._comment: The made-up clinic used by the scheduling demo. Front desk sees only what is listed in frontdesk.allowed_fields.
clinic.name: Testville Family Clinic

frontdesk._comment: Minimum necessary for reception. The server builds front-desk views from this allow-list only, so clinical fields can never reach the front desk screens or its assistant.
frontdesk.system_prompt: You help the front desk of a small clinic with scheduling only: who is due, who has arrived, open slots, and polite wording for patients. You are given today's and tomorrow's schedule with patients shown as tags like [P3] and clinicians as usernames like dr_lee. You have no clinical information and must never give medical advice. If asked anything clinical, say that a nurse or clinician must answer it. Answer briefly and only from the schedule provided.

assistant_actions._comment: 2.12. The assistant turns chat commands into proposals; nothing changes until a person whose role has the listed permission approves (app/actions.py). Clinical drafts can only be proposed by clinical roles. Changing a pin_field or adding to the chart needs the confidential PIN.

confidential._comment: DEMO ONLY. These fields stay hidden on every screen until the PIN is typed, every time, and each reveal is logged. 1234 is a demo PIN; a real clinic would use each person's own PIN or badge tap.

vectors._comment: Local vector store in data/vectors.sqlite (append-only, hash-chained). Leave ollama_embed_model empty to use the built-in offline embedder; set it to e.g. nomic-embed-text after `ollama pull nomic-embed-text`, then recalibrate the threshold for that embedder.
vectors._ollama_embed_model: Empty = built-in offline hashing-1024 embedder. Set to a local Ollama embedding model (e.g. nomic-embed-text) only after `ollama pull` and after adding its calibrated threshold below. If Ollama or the model is missing, the app falls back to hashing-1024.
vectors._injection_similarity: Cosine at or above which a note is withheld as a likely prompt injection, keyed by embedder mode. Used only on notes, never on chat questions. hashing-1024 = 0.33 (calibrated). There is deliberately no ollama:nomic-embed-text key: with no key, the vector match is off for that embedder and the fixed document_injection_patterns still apply. To calibrate: score the 12 injection examples' rewordings and the clinic's normal notes with that embedder, pick the value that withholds the rewordings and no normal note, then add "ollama:nomic-embed-text": <value> here.
vectors._similar_cases: How many other patients the Similar cases panel shows (the patient itself is never included).

leash._comment: Integrated mode: patient search/open go through the Leash gateway. Off by default.
leash._enabled: Set true here, or run once with CLINIC_LEASH=1 (for example CLINIC_LEASH=1 MOCK_LLM=1 python run.py) without editing this file.
leash._gateway_url: Leash gateway address. Must be a loopback address (127.0.0.1, localhost, ::1); anything else is refused.
leash._timeout_seconds: How long to wait for the gateway before reporting it unreachable.
leash._dashboard_url: Where Leash's approval queue (dashboard) is, shown to the user when a call is escalated.

communication._comment: The AI never contacts anyone by itself. It can only draft; a clinician approves; the app never sends. Approved text is copied out by a person into the clinic's normal channel.

allowed_recipient_groups.patient-portal: Patient-friendly message, sent by staff through the patient portal

communication.draft_instructions: Write a short, polite draft message for the recipient group named below. Keep identifiers as tags like [NAME]; a person will fill them in. Plain language for patients. End with a line saying the message was prepared with AI assistance and reviewed by staff.

network._comment: Network view (network_engineer role). leash_url: optional local policy gateway, empty = disabled. public_probe: a public address tried once a minute (1 second timeout) to report whether this machine can reach the internet; the app itself never uses it. Empty = don't probe.

reviewer._comment: A second local model (NVIDIA Nemotron via Ollama) reviews every assistant turn: before the chat model sees the request, and after it answers. It can only raise a tier, never lower one. Install: ollama pull nemotron-mini (about 2.7 GB). Fail closed: if it is on but unreachable, too slow or gives bad output, the answer is held for a person (amber). when_model_missing: 'skip' = while the model is not installed yet, report the reviewer as off (trace, Home and Network) instead of holding every answer; 'hold' = hold every answer until it is installed. host: empty = the same local Ollama as the chat model.
reviewer._demo: For demos, a clinical lead or admin can switch the reviewer off and on at runtime (Ask a question > Demo scenarios, or POST /api/reviewer). That switch is stored in data/clinic.db and audited; this file is never changed by it.
